passages.provision_quote: It is the policy of the state to do both of the following: (1) Achieve net zero greenhouse gas emissions as soon as possible, but no later than 2045, and to achieve and maintain net negative greenhouse gas emissions thereafter.
passages.note: Declares a net-zero/85%-reduction goal that names carbon capture and removal as paths; names no energy source (annex rung 1, H17).
Assembly floor concurrence vote; Lee voted Aye on AB 1279, within his earlier Assembly term.

rows.reasoning: AB 1279 (2021-2022), which Lee voted Aye on in the Assembly floor concurrence vote of 2022-08-31, declares state policy to reach net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2045 and an 85 percent reduction target, directing the state board to enable carbon dioxide removal and carbon capture/storage technologies to help meet those goals. This shows only the pro-action side; it names no energy source, so it cannot establish 'Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines' (annex H17).
